judgment.rationale: The supplied expectation closely matches the concrete labeling fix already owned by #50909. Route this report to that work rather than propose a separate launcher. evidence: On 0.102.3001, clicking the Mouse Without Borders Quick Access item appears to do nothing on both machines; the author expected the tool to open.

comment.body: The Mouse Without Borders Quick Access entry currently requests Refresh connections rather than opening a separate tool window. Its generic label makes that easy to misread; the existing fix is https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/50909, which labels it Reconnect. Use PowerToys Settings → Mouse Without Borders to open its settings. This explains the missing window, not a proven failure of pairing/reconnection itself.
